title: Your Bank Accounts Just Got Easier to Open: Understanding Video-KYC
description: Video-KYC (V-CIP) lets you complete bank and financial formalities from home via a video call. You no longer need to visit a bank branch for many account open.

faq.q: What documents do I need for Video-KYC?
faq.a: You typically need your original PAN card and Aadhaar card (or other valid address proof) ready during the call, as the official will need to see and verify them.

faq.q: Is Video-KYC available for all banking services?
faq.a: It's increasingly available for opening savings accounts, fixed deposits, credit cards, and some loan applications. However, the specific services offered via V-CIP can vary from bank to bank and financial institution to institution.

faq.q: What if my internet connection is poor during the call?
faq.a: A stable and good quality internet connection is crucial for a smooth V-CIP experience. If your connection is unstable, the video call might drop or the verification might fail, and you may need to restart the process.

faq.q: Can I do Video-KYC from anywhere?
faq.a: Yes, you can do it from any location with a stable internet connection and good lighting, as long as you are physically present in India and the location is private enough for you to share personal details securely.

faq.q: Is there a cost for Video-KYC?
faq.a: No, banks and financial institutions typically offer Video-KYC as a free service to facilitate customer onboarding and verification, making it more convenient for you.
